description: Send naira to a Nigerian bank account, paid from the linked wallet. ONLY for agents with a verified Self Agent ID: the request must be signed with the Self agent key (x-self-agent-* headers; see docs.abapays.com → Self Agent ID), otherwise it is refused before anything is charged. Call list_banks for the bank_code. The account name is checked before any money moves and returned in the result: confirm it with the human. ALWAYS requires the PIN — ask the human for it every time. Money moves for real. The result gives a reference: call get_payment_status with it to read the transfer reference and receipt once the transfer is sent.

amount_ngn.description: Amount in naira to send (whole naira, at least 100).

api_key.description: AbaPay MCP API key. NOT needed when the connector is authorized via OAuth — omit it entirely in that case.

chain.description: Optional. Defaults to the chain approved when the key was created.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, strongly recommended: a unique id for THIS transfer (8-128 chars). Retrying with the same key returns the first result instead of paying again.

pin.description: The PIN set when the API key was created. Required on EVERY payment — ask the human for it each time.

token.description: Optional stablecoin to pay with on that chain (e.g. "USDC", "USDT"). Defaults to the one approved when the key was created.

name: pay_bank_transfer
title: Pay Bank Transfer
